QuestInfo.name: Athena Pierce and Her Recovery
QuestInfo.0: Meet with Athena Pierce in Henesys.
QuestInfo.1: The wise man of Henesys, #bAthena Pierce#k, promised to give me the old piece of map in exchange for #b2 DEX Crystals#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Athena Pierce the DEX Crystal. Will you get the third Old Piece of Map?

0.0: I've heard about you before through #b#p1032001##k from Ellinia. We don't need to necessarily talk to each other to communicate; we communicate through our minds. You've worked hard to get here. But hey...you're looking for #b#t4031056##k? Of course I also happen to have the piece of the map that shows the book's whereabouts. I've forgotten about it for a while...
0.1: But I can't just give you that. I also have been giving away a little bit of my power to all the bowman-hopefuls for hundreds of years, but there have been a sudden rush of people wanting to be the bowman, I've used up most of my power as a result. Get me #b2 #t4005002#s#k and I'll help you find #b#t4031056##k. What do you think? Do you want to do it?

yes.0: Good choice. #t4005002# is something you can acquire from the monsters on land. Of course it won't be easy to get them but still, I think you are capable of doing it. I'll be waiting for you here. Best of luck to you!

no.0: Hmmm...but without my help you won't be able to find #b#t4031056##k, ever... anyway if you have a change of heart, please feel free to come back.

npc.0: Don't you want to feel the excitement of hunting down the monsters from out of nowhere? Only the Bowman can do that...

item.0: I really need you to get #b2 #t4005002# items#k. Don't be afraid of a little hard work, okay? Just keep fighting monsters and you'll find them.
